name: FxEmbed
description: Fix X/Twitter and Bluesky embeds! Use multiple images, videos, polls, translations and more on Discord, Telegram and others
one_liner: A free tool that fixes broken video, poll, and photo previews when you paste an X/Twitter or Bluesky link into Discord or Telegram.
buyer: A large Discord community owner or Telegram channel admin whose members constantly share social links that render as ugly, broken previews.
business_use_cases: A large gaming Discord server bakes fxtwitter link-rewriting into its welcome bot so shared clips always preview correctly for members.
A news-aggregation Telegram channel self-hosts an instance to guarantee uptime and branding control instead of depending on the public fxtwitter.com service.
A social-media management agency offers 'guaranteed working embeds' as a small value-add when setting up community Discord servers for clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid, guaranteed-uptime hosted instance for communities that don't want to self-host.
Bundle self-hosted setup as a line item in broader 'Discord server setup' consulting gigs.

steal_this: Self-host one instance behind a memorable custom domain and offer it free to three Discord communities you're already in, in exchange for a shoutout — this is a reputation/goodwill play, not really a business.
